claim: Hôtel-Dieu opens 9am–7:30pm continuously April 1–Nov 15 2026; off-season 9am–12:30pm and 2–6:30pm; open every day of the year, last ticket 1h before closing.
quote: January 1 – March 31: 9 AM–12:30 PM & 2–6:30 PM ... April 1 – November 15: 9 AM–7:30 PM ... November 16 – December 31: 9 AM–12:30 PM & 2–6:30 PM

claim: Base Hôtel-Dieu ticket is €9.50, reduced €6.25 (youth 6–17, students, jobseekers); free under 6.
quote: The basic Hôtel-Dieu ticket is €9.50, with a reduced price of €6.25 for students, large families, CEZAM card holders, tour guides, job seekers, and RSA beneficiaries.

claim: Marché aux Vins self-guided Découverte (5 wines) costs €25 online/€29 on-site; Prestige (7 wines) €49/€59; guided Exclusive €65; Tailor-made from €99.
quote: Découverte (5 wines): €25 online / €29 on-site ... Prestige (7 wines): €49 online / €59 on-site ... Exclusive (7 wines): €65 (max 10 people) ... Tailor-made (8 wines): From €99

claim: Marché aux Vins is at 2 Rue Nicolas Rolin in a former Cordeliers church with three intact chapels; open April–November 10am–7pm, tour departures 10–11am and 2–5pm.
quote: April-November: 10am-7pm ... Tours depart daily: 10am-11am and 2pm-5pm (no tours 12pm-2pm) ... Location: 2 Rue Nicolas Rolin, 21200 Beaune

claim: The Cité des Climats et Vins de Bourgogne in Beaune is a landmark building with 24-metre-high vine-like tendrils at 21 avenue Charles de Gaulle, devoted to the UNESCO-listed Climats of Burgundy.
quote: bright tendrils rising 24 meters high, evoking the way vines coil around trellises ... 21 avenue Charles de Gaulle, 21200 Beaune

claim: Cité tour costs €14.50 with reduced rates; open daily 10am–6pm low/mid season, 10am–7pm June 1–Sept 30 2026; annual closure Jan 5–18, 2026; reservation required.
quote: From June 1 to September 30, 2026 (high season): open every day from 10am to 7pm ... The price of experiences is €14.50 ... annual closure from January 5 to 18, 2026.

claim: Patriarche Père & Fils runs self-guided cellar visits with sommelier-led tasting of 6 Burgundy wines daily Jan 2–Dec 30 2026, departures 9:45am–4:45pm, capped at 10 per slot.
quote: departures at 9:45 am, 10:15 am, 10:45 am, 2:15 pm, 2:45 pm, 3:15 pm, 3:45 pm, 4:15 pm, and 4:45 pm, limited to 10 people per departure

claim: Patriarche occupies the former Visitandines convent and holds Burgundy's largest cellars (about 5 km of galleries).
quote: Maison Patriarche Père et Fils offers a self-guided tour of Burgundy's largest wine cellars

claim: Maison Joseph Drouhin's Oenothèque at 1 Cour du Parlement de Bourgogne offers visits by appointment only at 10am, 2pm and 4pm Monday–Saturday; tastings €38, €70 or €120 per person.
quote: visits at 10:00 am, 2:00 pm and 4 pm every day from Monday to Saturday included ... Tasting prices are 38€, 70€, or 120€ per person.

claim: Drouhin's cellars cover roughly 1 hectare in Beaune's historic centre between the Hospice and Notre-Dame, with sections dating to the Dukes of Burgundy and the Kings of France.
quote: These historical cellars cover approximately 1 hectare in the historical centre of Beaune, between the Hospice de Beaune and Notre-Dame Church

claim: Bouchard Aîné & Fils' '5 Senses' guided tour in 18th-century cellars tastes 5 wines (2 white, 3 red, Village and Premier Cru); departures 10:30, 11:30, 14:30, 16:00, 17:00, max 20 per group.
quote: Guided tours depart at 10:30, 11:30, 14:30, 16:00 and 17:00 with a limited number of places per tour (20) ... tasting of 5 wines including 2 white, 3 red, Village and Premier Crus

claim: Bouchard Père et Fils, founded 1731, owns 130 hectares in the Côte d'Or including 74 ha of premiers crus and 12 ha of grands crus; tours of the 15th-century Château de Beaune cellars include tastings of 6 or 8 wines.
quote: founded in 1731 by Michel Bouchard ... 130 hectares, including 74 hectares of premier crus and 12 hectares of grand crus vines ... private tours of the cellars of Château de Beaune, which is a 15th century fortress

claim: Moutarderie Fallot's Parcours Découvertes (Discovery Trail) runs daily Jan 2–Dec 31 2026 at 10am, 11:30am, 3pm, 4:30pm; €12 adult, €9 child/concession; shop open until 6pm.
quote: Every day from 2 January to 31 December 2026: 10am, 11.30am (tour in French AND English), 3pm, 4.30pm ... Adult rate: €12 (18 years and over) ... Child rate: €9

claim: Beaune's main weekly food market runs every Saturday 7am–1pm across Place de la Halle, Place Fleury and Avenue de la République with around 180 stalls of produce, cheese, meat, spices and organic farms.
quote: The market operates every Saturday from 7 AM to 1 PM ... around 180 traders ... fruit and vegetables, meat, cheeses, spices, roasters, organic produce and products from small farms

claim: From March to November the Saturday market is paired with a flea market on Place Carnot; the market is postponed by a day if it falls on May 1, Dec 25 or Dec 31.
quote: From March to November, the market is also accompanied by a flea market at Place Carnot ... except for 1st May, 25th and 31st December, when it is postponed by one day
